text: Every minute counts in a stroke. Would you spot the signs in time?
I know FAST. But what are the B and the E?
Gulf Region Nursing has sixty-seven clinical decision tools. Let's open BE-FAST.
The decision lens. Task, decisive clue, commit, reassess. Plus the boundary, the clinical pearl, and the trap.
Then the poster. Balance. Eyes. Face. Arm. Speech. Time.
What to watch for, when not to use it first, and what to consider instead. You can zoom, highlight and annotate.
Then practise. Ten coached questions, built around the same tool.
Balance and eyes. Now I'll catch it earlier.
